clips.speaker: hero.CourierBot
clips.text: Hauling the flag. Keep the path clear.

clips.speaker: hero.DefenseMech
clips.text: Den marked. Stay behind the shield.

clips.speaker: hero.DefenseMech
clips.text: Target accepted. Nothing gets past me.

clips.speaker: hero.DefenseMech
clips.text: Retreating to repair. I'll be back.

clips.speaker: hero.DefenseMech
clips.text: Something's out there. Not for long.

clips.speaker: hero.DefenseMech
clips.text: Aegis online. Point me at trouble.

clips.speaker: hero.EngineerBot
clips.text: Now that's a bounty I can weld.

clips.speaker: hero.EngineerBot
clips.text: On the books. Don't cheap out on me.

clips.speaker: hero.EngineerBot
clips.text: Tell the yard I'm worth it.

clips.speaker: hero.EngineerBot
clips.text: I'm an engineer, not a snack!

clips.speaker: hero.EngineerBot
clips.text: Fine. Hazard pay better be real.

clips.speaker: hero.EngineerBot
clips.text: I'll poke it. From a distance.

clips.speaker: hero.EngineerBot
clips.text: Hey! I'm billing you for that!

clips.speaker: hero.EngineerBot
clips.text: Not allowed? Fine. Your loss, not mine.

clips.speaker: hero.EngineerBot
clips.text: Orders say no. My wallet says ouch.

clips.speaker: hero.EngineerBot
clips.text: Somebody else can have that one.

clips.speaker: hero.EngineerBot
clips.text: Leaky hull. My favorite kind of money.

clips.speaker: hero.EngineerBot
clips.text: I'll patch it. Invoice to follow.

clips.speaker: hero.EngineerBot
clips.text: Talk fast. I bill by the minute.

clips.speaker: hero.GeologistBot
clips.text: Core sample logged. The lab will love this.

clips.speaker: hero.GeologistBot
clips.text: Reading the crust. On my way.

clips.speaker: hero.GeologistBot
clips.text: Fine. Quick, before the dust settles.

clips.speaker: hero.GeologistBot
clips.text: I understand rocks even more now.

clips.speaker: hero.GeologistBot
clips.text: Not cleared? The rocks will wait.

clips.speaker: hero.GeologistBot
clips.text: Time to compress for a while.

clips.speaker: hero.GeologistBot
clips.text: Core here. Look at this rock!

clips.speaker: hero.HarvesterBot
clips.text: That's a lot of ore. Yes.

clips.speaker: hero.HarvesterBot
clips.text: I'll hit it with a drill.

clips.speaker: hero.HarvesterBot
clips.text: Okay. More ore for someone else.

clips.speaker: hero.HarvesterBot
clips.text: Orders say no. I dig elsewhere.

clips.speaker: hero.HarvesterBot
clips.text: I dig holes. Fine, I'll fill one.

clips.speaker: hero.Medic
clips.text: On the wounded. Keep them breathing.

clips.speaker: hero.Medic
clips.text: I can't heal anyone if I'm scrap!

clips.speaker: hero.Medic
clips.text: I am not a hunter. But fine.

clips.speaker: hero.Medic
clips.text: Orders say no. I'll stay close.

clips.speaker: hero.Medic
clips.text: Hulls are just patients with rivets.

clips.speaker: hero.Medic
clips.text: Resting. Page me if it's serious.

clips.speaker: hero.Medic
clips.text: Medic. Try not to need me.

clips.speaker: hero.ScoutDrone
clips.text: Is this a scout job? It's not.

clips.speaker: hero.ScoutDrone
clips.text: Nobody wants a scout. Story of my life.

clips.speaker: hero.ScoutDrone
clips.text: Battery at two percent. Nap time.

clips.speaker: hero.SentinelMech
clips.text: I do not wander. I patrol.

clips.speaker: hero.SurveyorBot
clips.text: I'll mark it. Someone else shoot it.

clips.speaker: hero.SurveyorBot
clips.text: This is outside my job spec.

clips.speaker: hero.SurveyorBot
clips.text: That was not in the plan.

clips.speaker: hero.SurveyorBot
clips.text: Crack is point four meters. Sealing.

clips.speaker: hero.TerraformerBot
clips.text: Greening this crust. Slow work. Worth it.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Red alert. Please act before it becomes a lesson.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Colony lost. We will call it a learning experience.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Well. That is one way to end it.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Pad paid out. Dock fee already left. The Freeholds send their love. It is itemized.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Welcome to a rock that already has a landlord. Raise a Commons before the Freeholds invoice the crater.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: No Fobot Yard. Wrecks wait. Dock an Inn — that is the yard. Y does not skip the building.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: That is a decree, not a leash. Post it. If nobody wants it, that is a you problem.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: That red chip is water, not a coupon. Credits will not drink themselves. Build a farm or stop collecting roommates.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Colonists run the village. Robots take the contracts. Try not to mix them up — it gets philosophical.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Dock a Fobot Yard. Y is not a miracle. It is an invoice.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Stall is closed. We do not export lunch until the tank is fat. Try twelve. Try not dying.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Something just drank a unit of ice. That was not a sale.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Compact scrip insufficient. Re-fab a rookie or start a bake sale. Do not pay in ice.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Anvil wants 790. He can count. Raise the bounty or enjoy the scenery.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Life support is a suggestion until it is not. The tank is at four. People first, Anvil second.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Anvil is in the Fobot Yard. Standing him up costs more than the Scout. That is called having favorites.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Tax collector killed on the road

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Grid is skinny. Everyone is working at seventy percent, including your patience.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: See the crate on wheels? That is your tax collector. We are not calling it that. Do not click it.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Level 6 wreck, Compact scrip insufficient. Re-fab a rookie or start a bake sale. Do not pay in ice.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Credits were napping on the HAB. A mite just made a withdrawal.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Nobody is standing. You have twenty seconds of optimism left.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Credits are napping on the HAB. Haul will get around to it. Or a mite will. Gambling!

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Haul walked the purse home. That is your tax collector. We are not calling it that.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Junk-bot ate the levy. Congratulations, you have invented charity.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Flag still unpaid. The Compact does not work for exposure.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Open Hands: they will take a cheap flag. Hunger is past the greed gate. Courage is not.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Module destroyed. That was load bearing.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Objective complete. I will pretend I expected this.

clips.speaker: overseer
clips.text: Done. The Compact is almost impressed.
